scope: Focused closest-work audit, not exhaustive academic coverage. Summaries are auditor prose, not source abstracts.

records.title: MemTX: Transactional Belief Commit for Stateful Agent Memory
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: Belief lifecycle, risk-tiered visibility, per-record validate-and-commit, action gating and typed cascade repair. Its public manager is a useful CPU baseline. The paper permits partial commit and identifies fresh-transaction retry and undeclared provenance as protection boundaries.
overlap: Memory-specific transactional semantics and lifecycle fault suites are existing work.
Post-snapshot stale-write rejection precedes authority comparison in the stated protocol.
not_established: General arbitrary multi-record predicate serializability.
Durable OS-process recovery or an atomically enforced remote sink fence.
records.code_status: Pinned public source verified; no license identified. Selected source was inspected; sibling subsequently fetched the full archive and executed independent probes. See separate probe artifact for results.

records.title: Authorization Revocation for Long-Running AI Agents: Root-Scoped Quiescence under Delegation and Asynchronous Execution
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
locations: Exact rebind and durable conformance evaluation
records.scope: Root epochs, protected-effect fences, effect-envelope identity, receipt obligations and exact rebind address revocation during asynchronous execution. Evaluated effects are provider-free local-ledger effects under complete mediation and monotone durable authority assumptions.
overlap: Epoch plus receipt plus immutable effect binding is directly prior art.
Historical accepted effects and currently authorized new effects are explicitly separated.
not_established: Automatic mediation of arbitrary remote providers.
Memory extraction or arbitrary semantic duplicate equivalence.
records.code_status: No author implementation URL located in inspected primary PDF/HTML/landing page or focused title search. A cited third-party specification is not its artifact.

records.title: Revoked but Still Authoritative: An Empirical Study of Revocation Enforcement in Agent-Memory Systems
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: Five-system empirical revocation study connects memory exposure to unsafe downstream actions. Mem0 default expiry filtering hides expired records; the exposed arm intentionally includes them. Natural write-back and propagation extensions are Graphiti-specific.
overlap: Revocation persistence and retrieval-to-action failure are established empirical questions.
Default versus exposed or bypassed filtering must be controlled.
not_established: All five default configurations fail.
Concurrent write/delete ordering, receipt reclamation or process-crash recovery.
records.code_status: Pinned public source, Apache-2.0. Full experiment requires Neo4j/model endpoints; pyproject includes a sibling editable Graphiti dependency. Standalone guard selfchecks are narrower.

records.title: Forgetting Without Restarting: Execution-State Unlearning for Stateful LLM Agents
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: Forgetting changes transcript, derived memory, pending plans and caches through provenance-selected restoration and replay. The target is counterfactual execution state, assuming reproducible transitions, recorded tool observations and restorable environments.
overlap: Deleting a memory row alone does not erase derived plans or runtime influence.
Sanitized replay and dependency-aware forgetting are existing mechanisms.
not_established: Undoing arbitrary irreversible external effects.
Receipt identity lifetimes or exactly-once mutation admission.
records.code_status: No author artifact URL located in inspected primary sources/focused title search; reference links to other agent projects are not this implementation.

records.title: TOKI: A Bitemporal Operator Algebra for Contradiction Resolution in LLM-Agent Persistent Memory
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
locations: Keyed judge log and replay consistency
records.scope: Bitemporal memory operators specify winner/audit semantics and isolation preconditions. A keyed materialized judge decision stabilizes replay within its schedule model. PostgreSQL concurrency experiments distinguish real isolation from reference annotations.
overlap: Memory-specific history contracts, retained nondeterministic judge decisions and multi-writer isolation are direct antecedents.
Write skew and unsafe operator composition are already analyzed.
not_established: A general arbitrary remote-effect revocation protocol.
Availability of the advertised author repository at audit time.
records.code_status: Advertised repository returned HTTP 404 through GitHub and API. This is an availability observation, not evidence of fabrication or nonexistence.

records.title: Verified Detection and Prevention of Concurrency Anomalies in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Systems
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: Formal detectors and guarded runtimes cover stale generation, causal cascades, tool-registry changes and effect ordering. The paper explicitly treats the anomalies as classical. Higher-level executable verification and live-runtime deployments have different assurance scopes.
overlap: A small agent concurrency model or write-skew example is not a new principle.
Read–generate–write histories and snapshot insufficiency already have direct formal treatment.
not_established: Every deployed runtime implements every verified level.
A public author artifact URL from the inspected primary links.
records.code_status: Primary body describes an artifact bundle and runnable twins; no author hosting URL located among inspected links. Do not treat descriptions as a runnable baseline obtained by us.

records.title: Cordon: Semantic Transactions for Tool-Using LLM Agents
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: Semantic transactions bind result lineage, shadow local state, delegated authority and an effect outbox. Composed validation precedes release. Opaque or unsupported external effects can require audit and compensation rather than full containment.
overlap: Whole-task semantic validation before external release and an outbox are existing agent mechanisms.
Per-operation safety does not imply composed-plan safety.
not_established: Automatic reversibility or semantic visibility for arbitrary external services.
A public author implementation URL located in inspected primary links.
records.code_status: Paper reports an implementation; no author code URL located in inspected primary links. Conference template text alone does not establish acceptance.

records.title: Is Agent Memory a Database? Rethinking Data Foundations for Long-Term AI Agent Memory
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: GEM treats governed memory as an evolving state trajectory with version, dependency, provenance and active-state correctness. MemState demonstrates it on Kuzu. Several native-engine and trajectory-benchmark goals are research agenda rather than completed universal guarantees.
overlap: History-aware memory correctness and trajectory-level evaluation are prior conceptual work.
Current-value recall alone misses provenance, revision and footprint requirements.
not_established: A distributed revocation fence or durable operation-receipt protocol.
A fully implemented native engine for all proposed operators.
records.code_status: Author URL found in primary paper. Not fetched or executed in this bounded audit; no pinned runnable-baseline claim.

records.title: Revocation Is Not Complete at Receipt: An Executable Outcome Contract for Distributed Agent-Tool Gateways
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: A bounded C0–C5 monitor distinguishes revocation publication and receiver persistence from protected-effect prevention. The primary body includes real Keycloak/gateway and file/PostgreSQL effect surfaces, with frozen gateway/call/window contracts.
overlap: Acknowledgement or persisted revocation is insufficient evidence of enforcement.
Independent effect oracles and scope-frozen outcomes already have a direct agent-tool study.
not_established: Unbounded, all-provider revocation completion.
Memory semantic deduplication or a universal identity scheme.
records.code_status: This audit verifies the primary description, not a downloaded executable author baseline.

records.title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
records.publication_status: arXiv primary preprint; this audit does not certify peer review
records.verification: arXiv landing/PDF/HTML plus DataCite title/author metadata; targeted full-body sections inspected
records.scope: Generation identity, atomic predecessor fencing/successor activation and root-lifetime authority conservation prevent rollback from reminting authority. Guarantees assume complete mediation, authenticated records, durable monotone state and complete lineage.
overlap: Epoch rollback and fresh generation versus repeated logical occurrence are not unexplored authority problems.
Atomic admission and durable authority state are existing assumptions/mechanisms.
not_established: Unmediated arbitrary provider enforcement.
Semantic equivalence of extracted memory facts.
records.code_status: Primary model and evaluation description reviewed; no obtained runnable-baseline claim.
